title: Published evaluation evidence
description: Versioned, precomputed research results. Opening this page does not score a draft or run an LLM judge.

groups.title: Grammar screening
groups.scope: Research benchmark — not a model ranking
groups.summary: LanguageTool detected ordinary seeded errors, but its flags on generated Jason Lemkin-style drafts were often false alarms and did not clearly separate architectures.
groups.sample_size: 40 seeded ordinary-mistake sentences; 120 generated drafts audited

metrics.label: Clear mistakes in draft audit
metrics.detail: Most raw flags were style or vocabulary false alarms.

metrics.label: Architecture separation
metrics.detail: Grammar alone did not distinguish the evaluated systems.

limitations: LanguageTool is a screening tool, not an overall writing-quality grade.
Informal wording, brand names, and SaaS terminology can produce false alarms.

groups.title: Fixed-length blog voice distance
groups.scope: Blog-only research evidence — lower distance is closer to Jason Lemkin
groups.summary: Comparing equal-length excerpts removed draft-length bias. Relabel was closest to the real-post reference in this blog-focused test; PersonaRAG and Base Llama were farther away.
groups.sample_size: Fixed 100-word and 150-word blog excerpts; LinkedIn diagnostic only, X and talk unsupported

comparison.label: Distance by excerpt length (lower is closer)

metrics.label: Primary evaluation medium
metrics.detail: The reported metric is not validation for every format.

metrics.label: Relabel + RAG
metrics.detail: It is not a selectable method in the deployed app.

limitations: This is a style-distance measure, not factuality or usefulness.
The live candidate offers Base Llama, PersonaRAG, and direct QLoRA; it does not offer Relabel + RAG.

groups.title: RAG-v2 retrieval and cost evidence
groups.scope: RAG-v2 research only — not scores for the deployed candidate
groups.summary: These measurements came from Kevin's governed train-only retrieval experiment. They are displayed as migration evidence, not as measurements of the current PersonaRAG app.
groups.sample_size: 21,193-chunk train-only research index; live candidate uses the older approximately 37,525-chunk corpus

metrics.label: RAG prompt-token increase
metrics.detail: Approximately 70 tokens without RAG versus 360 with retrieved context.

metrics.label: Evidence extraction time
metrics.detail: About 7–8 seconds per draft when split across four drafts.

metrics.label: Unsupported-number diagnostic
metrics.detail: A diagnostic requiring source review, not a live quality score.

metrics.label: Requested-passage type fit
metrics.detail: Medium filtering was especially weak for X and talk due to corpus composition.

limitations: RAG-v2 is not connected to the React/FastAPI candidate and its index was not rebuilt on EC2.
Do not compare these research numbers directly with drafts generated by the live PersonaRAG candidate.

groups.title: Model F graph-context evidence
groups.scope: Integration pending — no live Model F result is displayed
groups.summary: The Model F graph-context implementation is being integrated behind a disabled feature boundary. The completed LightRAG index and four-arm live experiment have not been delivered or run on this candidate.
groups.sample_size: No accepted snapshot or live Model F sample yet

metrics.label: CPU implementation tests
metrics.detail: Reported by the teammate handoff; not re-run against a completed graph snapshot.

metrics.label: Live hybrid retrieval
metrics.detail: Blocked until the verified snapshot arrives.

metrics.label: Four-arm experiment
metrics.detail: Must run after live retrieval validation.

limitations: Model F is not a selectable generation method in the live candidate.
No partial LightRAG index is mounted, queried, or represented as a result.
